michaung_nb19.listed_title: National Bulletin based on 00:00:00 UTC of 04-12-2023
michaung_nb19.note: IMD National Bulletin No. 19 (BOB/06/2023), Cyclonic Storm MICHAUNG, issued 0845 IST 4 Dec 2023. Every field (centre 13.2N 81.2E at 0530 IST, the forecast track, the fishermen warning) is read from the PDF by sources/imd_parser.py at load, the same parser the live feed uses; nothing here is typed by hand. A past bulletin replayed with the storm.
